Banded.svelte exposes the label-column width as the labelWidth='narrow'|'wide' enum, matching the neutral labelWidth feature. align ('center' → --middle) and labelTextAlign / valueTextAlign (center|end → --label-* / --value-*) are enums named for the CSS they drive; isTruncate is a bool. body → the children snippet; extraClass → the class passthrough. Per-ROW structure (pa-banded__row/__label/__value/__copy) is the BandedRow.svelte sub-component, deferred in the fixture.
